question.text: Under the default (new) tax regime per Section 115BAC(1A), the surcharge cap applicable to a trust taxed at MMR is:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook (pp. 367, 372) states: "Under this new regime [115BAC(1A)], the rate of surcharge shall be capped at 25% (instead of 37%)." This is the directly sourced surcharge cap for trusts under the default regime. The Trap: 37% was the old-regime peak surcharge. 15% is a special LTCG/STCG surcharge cap. 10% is a lower surcharge slab. None of these reflect the 25% cap specified by Section 115BAC(1A). Note: The workbook separately cites 42.744% as the MMR rate applicable to F&O income for Category III AIFs — that figure belongs to a different context and is not a substitute for the 25% surcharge cap under the default regime.
